correctness.rationale: The supplied multiplication table reconstructs a five-by-five real-linear L_p. Independent SymPy reconstruction (not executing the supplied checker) verifies det L_p=N(p)F(p), det R_p=N(p)F(conjugate p) as exact polynomial identities, with N=a²+2(b²+c²+d²+e²)>0 outside zero. In orthogonal coordinates x=S/sqrt3,y,z the identity ∂aF+∂eF=3[(a−e)²+x²] forces a=e,x=0 at every real cubic singularity; ∂aF then forces y=z=0. Conversely [1:0:0:0:1] is singular, with directly checked rank L=3 and R=5; conjugate has the reversed ranks. Rank≤3 implies all 4-minors vanish, hence det-gradient zero, so the sole exceptional line is exhaustive. On F=0 away from it rank=4, and otherwise rank=5. The real-field and canonical-gamma=1 qualifications are essential; a finite integer grid is not an infinite-field proof.
